scripts.db:up: docker start kairox-pg 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name kairox-pg --restart unless-stopped -e POSTGRES_USER=kairox -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=kairox -e POSTGRES_DB=kairox -p 5432:5432 -v kairox_postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:17-alpine
scripts.db:push: docker exec -i kairox-pg psql -U kairox -d kairox -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < lib/db/schema.sql
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it kairox-pg psql -U kairox -d kairox
